record.context_brief: Extending the semi-positive curvature structure theorem
record.original_question: Can the structure theorem proved for smooth projective varieties with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, including the locally trivial MRC fibration and the splitting description of the universal cover, be generalized to compact Kahler manifolds?

evidence.quote: It is an attractive problem to generalize the above structure theorem to compact Kahler manifolds.
Problem 3.5. Can we generalize Theorem 3.4 to compact Kahler manifolds?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold admitting a Kähler metric of semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature (i.e., for every nonzero tangent vector $v$ of type $(1,0)$, the holomorphic sectional curvature $H(v) \ge 0$). For a smooth projective variety, the following structure theorem is known: there exists a maximal rationally connected (MRC) fibration $\varphi: X \dashrightarrow Y$ which is everywhere defined, smooth, and locally trivial (with rationally connected fiber $F$ admitting a Kähler metric of semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature), $Y$ has identically zero holomorphic sectional curvature, and the universal cover $\widetilde{X}$ splits holomorphically and isometrically as a product $\mathbb{C}^k \times \widetilde{F}$ (so in particular the MRC fibration lifts to the trivial product fibration after passing to the universal cover).

Problem: Does the same structure theorem hold for an arbitrary compact Kähler manifold $X$ (not assumed projective) carrying a Kähler metric of semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature? More precisely, must $X$ admit a smooth locally trivial MRC fibration $\varphi: X \to Y$ onto a compact Kähler manifold $Y$ of identically zero holomorphic sectional curvature, with rationally connected fiber, such that the universal cover of $X$ splits holomorphically and isometrically as $\mathbb{C}^k \times \widetilde{F}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of extending the projective structure theorem for semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature to the compact Kähler setting appears to remain a research question being actively pursued. Recent preprints (2024–2025) by Matsumura and by Zhang–Zhang study the fundamental groups and partial semi-positivity in the Kähler case, and a related structure/splitting theorem has been obtained for compact Kähler manifolds with non-negative mixed curvature. However, no source clearly states a complete generalization of the full projective structure theorem (MRC locally trivial fibration plus universal cover splitting) to all compact Kähler manifolds. Status appears partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: On Kähler manifolds with non-negative mixed curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Structure theorem and Cheeger–Gromoll-type splitting for compact Kähler manifolds with non-negative mixed curvature (linear combination of Ricci and holomorphic sectional curvature).
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress toward structure/splitting theorems in the compact Kähler setting under curvature hypotheses related to holomorphic sectional curvature.

status_evidence.title: Matsumura - fundamental groups of compact Kähler manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the structure of compact Kähler manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, partial extension of the projective structure theorem.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing work extending parts of the projective structure theorem to compact Kähler manifolds.
